verdict.rationale: Attio offers AI features (search/update/create with AI, drafting follow-ups, call transcription, workflow-building via natural language) and an MCP server enabling AI assistants like Claude/ChatGPT to manage the workspace, which supports task delegation. However, this is more of an integration/agent-building layer than a single unified 'built-in AI assistant' with clear delegation UX, and evidence is largely marketing copy without hands-on confirmation of reliability or scope.
